name: Order Procedure.xmind
text:
# Sheet: 画布 1
- Order Procedure
  - Step 1/Product Discussion
    - Finalize Specification, Quantity, Customized Requirements...
Move on to Step 2
    - No agreement is achieved due to pricing, unavailable offer...
Wait for next business opportunity
  - Step 2/Ordering
    - Customer sends PO
      - This is not necessarily required
    - Seller drafts PI
      - Required
      - Contact info, pricing, qu'antity, shipping time... 
should be specified in this invoice
    - Customer checks
      - Make payment if PI is fine
      - Notifies seller to revise the points in question
  - Step 3/Payment
    - PayPal/Bank transfer ONLY
      - PayPal is usually for sample order of small invoice value
5Usd will be charged for every 100Usd into our PayPal account
This cost is taken away by PayPal(transaction cost)
      - Bank transfer is usually about repeat and bulk order
Standard charge for each order: 25usd
    - Customer sends payment receipt
      - Material preparation starts off
    - Seller receives payment
      - Production starts off
  - Step 4/Shipping
    - Dispatch ready
      - Order photos and videos available
      - Customer confirmation is required to release out the order
    - Shipping method
      - Customer designated forwarder
        - This is usually about customer's shipping agent
We will directly send purchased items to agent for further processing
      - Our shipping agent
        - We will quote based on total weight to customer
It is usually air service by DHL/FedEx/UPS
If this is fine, this cost will be included in PI(Step 2)
      - Customer shipping account
        - We support shipment via customer's shipping a/c
    - Shipping number
      - Seller should send awb to customer once available
